title: Asking for and paying the bill
summary: Get the bill, pack leftovers, split the payment, fix a wrong dish and choose how to pay.

anything-else.speaker: Waiter
anything-else.pinyin: Hái xūyào diǎn bié de ma?

variants.en: Would you like to add any dishes?

rephrase.pinyin: Nín hái xiǎng zài diǎn shénme ma?
rephrase.en: Is there anything more you'd like to order?

choices.en: Could you pack this up for me?

pack.speaker: Waiter
pack.zh: 可以，打包盒一块钱一个。
pack.pinyin: Kěyǐ, dǎbāo hé yí kuài qián yí ge.
pack.en: Sure. Takeaway boxes are one yuan each.

choices.pinyin: Hǎo de, zài bāng wǒ mǎidān.

split.speaker: Waiter
split.zh: 可以，你们每个人扫这个码，各付各的。
split.pinyin: Kěyǐ, nǐmen měi ge rén sǎo zhège mǎ, gè fù gè de.
split.en: Sure. Each of you scan this code and pay for your own.

rephrase.zh: 没问题，一个人一个人扫码付就行。
rephrase.pinyin: Méi wèntí, yí ge rén yí ge rén sǎo mǎ fù jiù xíng.
rephrase.en: No problem — just scan and pay one person at a time.

choices.zh: 我们平分吧，一个人多少？
choices.pinyin: Wǒmen píngfēn ba, yí ge rén duōshao?
choices.en: Let's split it evenly — how much each?

split-amount.speaker: Waiter
split-amount.zh: 一共两百四，一个人一百二。
split-amount.pinyin: Yígòng liǎng bǎi sì, yí ge rén yìbǎi èr.

wrong-dish.speaker: Waiter
wrong-dish.zh: 不好意思，我看一下……是我们弄错了，这个不算钱。
wrong-dish.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ kàn yíxià... shì wǒmen nòng cuò le, zhège bú suàn qián.
wrong-dish.en: Sorry, let me check... it was our mistake. We won't charge for it.

pay-how.speaker: Waiter
pay-how.zh: 好的，一共一百八十六。扫码还是刷卡？
pay-how.pinyin: Hǎo de, yígòng yìbǎi bāshíliù. Sǎo mǎ háishi shuā kǎ?
pay-how.en: Okay, 186 in total. Scanning a code, or card?

rephrase.zh: 您用手机付，还是用银行卡？
rephrase.pinyin: Nín yòng shǒujī fù, háishi yòng yínhángkǎ?
rephrase.en: Are you paying by phone or by bank card?

choices.pinyin: Kěyǐ shuā wàiguó de kǎ ma?
choices.en: Can I use a foreign card?
Can I get an official receipt (fapiao)?

card.speaker: Waiter
card.zh: 不好意思，外国卡刷不了。可以用支付宝或者现金。
card.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, wàiguó kǎ shuā bu liǎo. Kěyǐ yòng Zhīfùbǎo huòzhě xiànjīn.
card.en: Sorry, we can't take foreign cards. You can use Alipay or cash.

choices.pinyin: Nà wǒ péngyou bāng wǒ fù ba.
choices.en: Then my friend will pay for me

fapiao.speaker: Waiter
fapiao.zh: 可以，扫这个码填一下抬头就行。
fapiao.pinyin: Kěyǐ, sǎo zhège mǎ tián yíxià táitóu jiù xíng.
fapiao.en: Sure — scan this code and fill in the name for the receipt.

choices.pinyin: Hǎo de, ránhòu wǒ sǎo mǎ fùkuǎn.
choices.en: Okay, then I'll scan to pay

paid-end.speaker: Waiter
paid-end.zh: 收到了，谢谢！慢走，欢迎下次再来。
paid-end.pinyin: Shōudào le, xièxie! Màn zǒu, huānyíng xià cì zài lái.
paid-end.en: Got it, thank you! Take care, and come again.

friend-end.speaker: Waiter
friend-end.zh: 好的，请这位扫一下码。谢谢！
friend-end.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐng zhè wèi sǎo yíxià mǎ. Xièxie!
friend-end.en: Okay — would you (the friend) scan the code, please? Thank you!

cash-end.speaker: Waiter
cash-end.zh: 收您两百，找您十四块。谢谢，慢走！
cash-end.pinyin: Shōu nín liǎng bǎi, zhǎo nín shísì kuài. Xièxie, màn zǒu!
cash-end.en: 200 received, 14 back in change. Thanks, take care!
cash-end.outcome: You pay cash and get your change.
